title: Grey Prince
description:
Grey Prince is a first-person horror adventure that combines exploration, melee combat, puzzle solving, and survival elements.

Descend into dangerous underground dungeons filled with undead enemies, hidden secrets, and shifting environments. Solve environmental puzzles and fight through skeletal warriors while uncovering the mysteries buried beneath the ruins.

Every descent presents new dangers as dungeon layouts change and enemies appear in unexpected locations. Careful exploration and resource management are essential if you hope to survive and find a way to escape.

Features

First-person exploration

Melee-based combat with a souls-like stamina system

Environmental and logic puzzles

Procedurally varied dungeon layouts

Atmospheric horror experience

Single-player gameplay

Fight. Survive. Explore. Solve puzzles. Escape.
description_short: Grey Prince offers brutal combats which every fight is a fight to death. Explore, get lost, solve puzzles, nagivate around forbidden dungeons to escape this unjust nightmare. Unravel the story of a forgotten prisoner for his fight for survival and escape.
